summary: Completed frontend testing for FortexaRH lazy loading and i18n optimization refactoring. All 6 test cases PASSED: Landing page loads immediately, Login page loads correctly, Dashboard loads after login, Lazy-loaded pages (PayrollV2, Employees, Vacations) load with PageLoader, Language switching works with lazy-loaded i18n, Navigation between pages is smooth.
critical_code_review_comments: Lazy loading implementation is well-structured with React.lazy() and Suspense
Critical pages (Landing, Login, Dashboard) are correctly kept synchronous for fast initial load
i18next-http-backend properly configured to load translations on demand
PageLoader component provides good UX during page transitions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lazy loading refactoring is complete and working. 45 pages converted to lazy loading using React.lazy(). i18n uses i18next-http-backend for on-demand translation loading. All critical pages (Landing, Login, Dashboard) load synchronously. Language switching works correctly across all pages including lazy-loaded ones.

landing_page_load.details: Landing page loads immediately with 7732+ characters of content. No blank screen issue. FortexaRH branding visible. Load time ~1.42s.

login_page_load.details: Login page loads correctly with email/password form, Google OAuth option, and language selector. All form elements functional.

dashboard_load_after_login.details: Dashboard loads correctly after login. Shows 'Good morning, Test!' greeting, Active Employees (6), Pending Payrolls (6), Monthly Payroll Summary. Sidebar navigation fully functional.

lazy_loaded_payroll_v2.details: PayrollV2 page (lazy-loaded) loads correctly with Payroll Management content. Shows Dashboard, Periods, Payroll Sheet tabs. Open Periods: 0, Pending Payrolls: 1, Total Paid: RD$190,974.57.

lazy_loaded_employees.details: Employees page (lazy-loaded) loads correctly with Employee Management content. Shows 6 employees with Name, Department, Position, Salary, Status columns.

lazy_loaded_vacations.details: Vacations page (lazy-loaded) loads correctly with full Spanish translations. Shows 'Gestión de Vacaciones y Licencias', Solicitudes Pendientes: 2, Aprobadas: 2.

language_switching.details: Language switching works correctly with lazy-loaded i18n. Tested EN->ES switch on login page. All UI elements translated: 'Log In' -> 'Iniciar Sesión', 'Email' -> 'Correo electrónico', 'Password' -> 'Contraseña'. Translations persist across lazy-loaded pages.

navigation_between_pages.details: Navigation between lazy-loaded pages is smooth. Tested: Dashboard -> PayrollV2 -> Employees -> Reports -> Vacations. All pages load with correct content and translations.

performance_observations.initial_load: Landing page loads in ~1.42s with full content
performance_observations.lazy_loading: Lazy-loaded pages show PageLoader briefly during transition, then load full content
performance_observations.i18n_loading: Translations load on-demand via HTTP backend, no noticeable delay
